item.title: Columbus OKs support for renewable energy choice bill
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- Columbus City Council is adding its voice to a growing list of cities supporting more renewable energy choices in Ohio. Councilmembers passed a resolution urging the statehouse to pass the Community Energy Bill, House Bill 303. item.title: Where to take photos with the Easter Bunny around central Ohio in 2026
item.description: Families, pets, and those with sensory-friendly needs can capture the perfect springtime memory with the Easter Bunny at various locations in central Ohio, including Cabela's, Colony Square Mall, Columbus Zoo and Aquarium, Easton Town Center, Polaris Fashion Place, The Cakehound, The Mall at Tuttle Crossing, and River Valley Mall.
